data.title: DPRK Internal Platform Network Connection Detection
data.description: Detect connections to DPRK-associated internal collaboration platforms OConnect VPN and NetKey VPN, identified by Flare and IBM X-Force as tools used by DPRK IT workers: (1) VPN connections to known OConnect or NetKey IP address ranges, (2) DNS queries resolving OConnect or NetKey domains, (3) VPN protocol signatures matching OConnect or NetKey handshake patterns, particularly from endpoints that are simultaneously connected to corporate VPN infrastructure. Dual-VPN usage is a strong indicator of DPRK IT worker activity on compromised enterprise networks.

enrichment_required.source: Network analytics enrichment (concurrent VPN session detection)
Endpoint telemetry enrichment (non-corporate VPN process detection)

falsepositives: Legitimate OConnect videoconferencing usage in organizations where it is an approved tool
